summary.headline: Chapters 5–28 of Annual Astrology
summary.text: Continuation of a chapter list covering annual lord determination, planetary testimonies and strength, luminaries in angles, royal and popular judgments, Mercury and Moon, retrogradation, wars, the three superior planets, and the Moon’s Dragon head and tail.
